easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Lumbering Battlement, and Lagrella must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Lagrella for its mana cost.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Lagrella until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
